en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a dirty book
Let's read manga
This is boring...
I see...

You are quite...excited to show the opposite
gender this kind of reading material.

I do not have any authority to reject,
but I am going to reject it anyway.
Maids have the right to refuse requests.
I do not mind.

I will use it as future reference. But
which manga genre do you prefer?

It is part of a maid's duty to know the
client's hobby.

So when I receive a similar request in the
future, my service will be more convenient.

Is this a request...? 
Do you wish for me to entertain you?
If so, then I will fetch a book for you.

Do not worry. From my past profiling, I
have a grasp on your likes and dislikes.

<CLT=cltMIND>You know all that just
by profiling me?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
